lessons: The unit coverage check failed on chupa/tickets.py. test-gate.toml sets that file's minimum at 11%, and the check counts only tests/unit. The 73 new lines in tickets.py were tested only by integration tests, so the file's coverage fell below 11%.

The ticket cannot pass as written. Its Scope fence lists no tests/unit file, but the coverage check can only be met by unit tests. Revise the ticket to fence a new unit test file, for example tests/unit/test_tickets_context.py, and name it in Scope in.

With that file fenced, add unit tests that run the new section-resolution function directly on small temporary .py and .md files. Cover both the found and not-found cases, the duplicate heading, and a section listed alongside its whole file.

Do not lower the tickets.py or stages.py minimum in test-gate.toml. The gate file says only a human ticket may lower a threshold. Also check that the stages.py change does not drop that file below its 12% minimum.
Before reporting ok, run the same unit coverage command the check runs on tests/unit. Running only ./dev.py test hid this failure because those tests passed.
